title: A Founder’s Guide to Meta Advantage Plus Shopping Campaigns

facts.fact: Meta claims Advantage+ Shopping Campaigns delivered a 17% lower cost per conversion on average compared to manual shopping campaigns (vendor's own claim, as reported by the article).
facts.quote: Meta claims that Advantage+ Shopping Campaigns delivered a **17% lower cost per conversion** on average compared to manual campaigns.

facts.fact: According to Meta, advertisers using Advantage+ shopping campaigns saw 17% more purchases per $1 spent than advertisers using manual shopping campaigns (vendor's own claim).
facts.quote: "For every $1 advertisers spent using Advantage+ shopping campaigns, they saw 17% more purchases compared to advertisers who used manual shopping campaigns."

facts.fact: The article reports that Advantage+ CPM costs have skyrocketed 94% year-over-year since mid-2024 (third-party figure cited via backbone.media, not a Meta number).
facts.quote: its CPM costs have skyrocketed **94% year-over-year** since mid-2024.

facts.fact: In one test cited by the article, an apparel brand found only 17% of reported Advantage+ conversions were truly incremental (third-party test, not a Meta number).
facts.quote: In one test, an apparel brand found only **17%** of reported conversions were truly incremental

facts.fact: The article recommends running manual campaigns first for a new product because Advantage+ has no conversion data to learn from.
facts.quote: The algorithm has no conversion data to learn from. You must run manual campaigns first to feed the pixel and gather initial data.

facts.fact: The page advises launching a Meta Advantage+ campaign with at least 5-10 distinct creative concepts.
facts.quote: Plan on launching with at least **5-10 distinct creative concepts**.

facts.fact: The page gives a rule of thumb that an Advantage+ budget should be able to generate at least 50 conversions per week.
facts.quote: A good rule is a budget that can get you **50 conversions per week**.

facts.fact: When testing new creative inside an ASC campaign, the page recommends adding 3-5 new creative concepts to the live campaign.
facts.quote: Add **3-5 new creative concepts** directly into the live campaign.

facts.fact: The page recommends letting a campaign run with current creative for at least one week to establish a baseline before testing new creative.
facts.quote: Let your campaign run with your current creative for at least a week.

facts.fact: According to Jon Loomer Digital, Meta's own tests showed Advantage+ Audience led to a 28% lower CPC.
facts.quote: Meta's own tests have shown that Advantage+ Audience can lead to a **28% lower CPC**

facts.fact: According to Jon Loomer Digital, Meta's own tests showed Advantage+ Audience led to a 7% lower cost per website conversion.
facts.quote: a **7% lower cost per website conversion**. (Source: Jon Loomer Digital)

facts.fact: The page states that the existing customer budget cap is a setting that controls what percentage of the campaign budget can be spent on people who have already purchased.
facts.quote: This tells Meta what percentage of your budget can be spent on people who've already bought from you.
